text:
Amy (CS): quick heads-up — Spruce's UX org pinged me: they're planning to roll personalization to 3 new squads next month and want a pilot for realtime summarization + embeddings. potential throughput spike during launch windows.

Liam (Spruce - PM): yup, we're targeting mid-May. initial use case: session summaries + product recommendations for new users. expecting bursty traffic during peak hours (mornings PST).

Raj (CS Ops): do we have ballpark QPS / token estimates? helps size dedicated vs hosted.

Liam (Spruce - PM): rough numbers: baseline ~ 40 RPS, peak bursts up to 250 RPS for ~15-30m windows. avg request ~ 600 tokens. also want low single-digit 95p latency.

Marta (Solutions Eng): thanks — sounds like a mixed workload (longer contexts for summaries, shorter for re-rank/embed calls). we should consider a hybrid route: hosted for baseline, short dedicated pool for predictable burst. can we get example payloads?

Amy (CS): I'll ask for sample payloads + expected concurrency by squad. @Marta can you sketch a recommended pilot topology (canary + burst path) and an ops playbook?

Marta (Solutions Eng): will do. first pass:
- canary on hosted API with prefix caching enabled
- dedicated pod for bursts (pre-warmed GPUs) with auto-burst policy to pull from hosted as fallback
- KV cache for session summaries to cut tokens for repeat calls

onboard-bot: checklist item added: "Spruce pilot: collect payloads + security classification" :white_check_mark:

Raj (CS Ops): any security or PII concerns? Spruce deals with user messages and PII in product content. we should confirm redaction + KMS requirements.

Liam (Spruce - PM): confirmed: PII present but tokenizable. they need KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and audit logs. also they want SSO for team access.

Amy (CS): flagged for Private/Dedicated options + security package. @Marta can you include KMS/handoff notes in the ops playbook? We'll also note renewal watch — if this pilot drives org expansion, it's a cross-sell signal but also means we need tight enablement to avoid slippage.

Marta (Solutions Eng): adding: KMS steps, onboarding runbook, sample canary config. quick snippet I recommend for canary rate limiting:
```json
{"route": "/summaries", "rate_limit": "200rps", "burst_window": "30s", "fallback_route": "/summaries-hosted"}
```

Raj (CS Ops): good. can we set up a 30-min prep session with Spruce engineering next week to capture payloads and agree SLAs? I'll propose times.

Liam (Spruce - PM): wed or thurs morning PST works. tx — we want an estimate for cost & timeline to present to our leadership by end of next week.

Amy (CS): action items:
- Liam: share sample payloads + list of squads and expected launch dates (by EOD Tue)
- Marta: draft pilot topology + security/KMS steps + cost estimate (first pass by Wed)
- Raj: schedule prep call (+ invite SE, infra, and account exec)
- Amy: prepare renewal/expansion note for CSM leadership (capture as "potential expansion")

Marta (Solutions Eng): will include quantization + batching recommendations to reduce cost per token. also include fallback policy for model variants.

Liam (Spruce - PM): thanks team — excited to ramp. i'll drop a sanitized example payload here after the call. :thumbsup:

Amy (CS): perfect. marking this as a high-priority expansion lead. I'll update the account health doc and flag renewal watch if we see committed pilots. :eyes:
